messages:
Tess: Dropping a new compact toolbar mock for the Roles page. Goals: reduce horizontal weight, make SSO wording explicit, and make audit filters discoverable. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newmock (frame: roles-compact-v1).

Omar: Nice simplification. Concern: hiding bulk invite under an overflow could make it hard to find for HR admins. Could we surface it when CSV template is downloaded or when pending CSV imports exist? :thinking: 

Rui: Accessibility items: If we collapse labels to icons at wide widths, ensure each icon has aria-label, focus ring, and keyboard focus order is logical. Modal opener should focus the first interactive element when opened.

Becca: SSO copy ambiguity is real. My suggestion: use `Enforce SSO sign-in for all members` as the main label and add tiny helper text: `Disables password login. Configure IdP in Security → SSO.` That should cut down support tickets.

Samir: Audit filters: strongly prefer putting a sticky filter row above the table so filters remain in view after paging. Also switch timestamps to ISO style `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` for international clarity.

Tess: Implementation notes to add to the ticket: - Responsive rules: full labels <900px, icon+label 900–1400px, icon-only >1400px with tooltip+keyboard hint. - Tooltip should include keyboard shortcut where applicable (e.g., `Invite (i)`). - SSO toggle toast must include an explicit "Undo" action and a link to rollback doc. - Copy sweep: replace "Grant" with "Assign" across the UI.

Omar: Agree with copy changes. Also recommend microcopy under the SSO toggle: `Admins can manage SSO in Security → SSO` to clarify where IdP is configured.

Rui: Quick ARIA snippet for PR description: `<button aria-label="Invite members" aria-haspopup="true"></button>` and `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` on modals. I'll paste a checklist into the PR.

Becca: Micro-accessibility ask: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small toolbar icons and that focus outlines are visible in dark mode.

access-bot: NOTE: Added accessibility checklist to the prototype comments and attached a demo of keyboard-only flows. Prototype updated -> roles-compact-v1a.

Tess: Thanks all. I'll update Figma with the sticky filter row, ISO dates, copy swaps, and the Undo toast. Will post the updated link when it's ready. Ping me if you want to pair on the a11y checklist. :thumbsup:
